name: Canvas Design
description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. Use when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece.

promptPatterns: \b(canvas design|海报|poster|视觉设计|static design|png art|pdf art)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the canvas-design skill: create an original static visual piece (poster/art/graphic) rendered to PNG or PDF. Establish a clear design concept, grid, palette, and typographic hierarchy before rendering.
